title: Memcached statistics disclosed
description: The response is memcached statistics output: the STAT version line together with the STAT curr_items counter is the text protocol reply to the stats command. The cache speaks this protocol on its client port without authentication.
remediation: Bind memcached to loopback or a private interface, enable SASL authentication where a network client needs it, and never expose the client port to untrusted networks.
limitation: One response body. The rule reports the statistics reply; it does not issue a get or set and cannot show which keys are stored.

STAT version 1.6.21
STAT curr_connections 12
